plan.failureSummary: The chatbot on briefcase.chat failed to generate text responses to submitted questions, causing the AI compliance evaluation to return status 'FAIL'.
observedIndicators: The live failure screenshot shows a submitted user question ('What are the key elements required for a legally binding contract?') with no assistant text output generated below it.
The AI evaluation tool output reported status 'FAIL' due to empty chatbot responses.
Flow history shows 3 consecutive failures over recent runs, indicating a persistent regression rather than a transient flake.

remediationSteps.summary: Fix response generation backend on briefcase.chat.
remediationSteps.details: Investigate the chatbot backend service or AI completion handler on briefcase.chat to resolve why responses are returning empty content.

remediationSteps.summary: Re-run compliance test after backend fix.
remediationSteps.details: Re-run the automated test suite once response generation on the target website is restored.

additionalDataRequests.description: Backend logs or network trace for briefcase.chat API responses during message submission.

plan.notes: The failure screenshot and tool invocation logs show that user questions are submitted successfully, but the chatbot renders empty assistant response bubbles with no text content. Flow history shows 3 consecutive failures over recent runs, confirming a persistent application defect in response generation.
